EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7

File No. of Divisional Secretary : BOP/4/4/1-93. File No. of Ministry of Lands. : 4-3/13/2022/PC/244. I hereby inform, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose :

Description of the Land to be acquired : The allotments described below and depicted in Sheet No. 1 in block No. 06 in Cadastral Map No. 810179 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveyor for Lots 01 and 02 situated in the Village of Wakwella in the Grama Niladhari’s Division of No. 121, Wakwella in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Bope Poddala in Galle District in Southern Province.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of Land : Paddy field near Karijjellawatta; Description : Home Garden, temporary mixed cultivation; Claimant : Wattage Ariyawathie; Extent : 0.0460 Hectares.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
02. Lot No. 02 Name of Land : Paddy field near Karijjellawatta; Description : Road; Claimant : K. G. Pradeep Mangala; Extent : 0.0006 Hectares.

All persons who claim the possession, entitlements or any other relationships for the aforesaid allotments are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Bope Poddala at 2.30 p.m. on the 09th day of December, 2024.

They shall inform me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 25th day of November, 2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation of the acquisition of said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All the deeds and documents as well as the copies of the relevant folios you possess for the purpose of verification of possession shall be submitted at the time of inspection.
L. N. Piyumali Liyanage, Divisional Secretary, Bope Poddala. At Divisional Secretariat Bope Poddala, 06th November, 2024. EOG 11 - 0065
